subject.title: [Feature Request] Add option to disable 'new messages' notification banner in WebChat

question: Should WebChat add a browser-local preference to hide or reduce the New messages indicator while preserving a separate manual catch-up affordance?
rationale: Current main deliberately uses the indicator for manual catch-up, especially with auto-scroll off, while repository policy discourages unnecessary gateway configuration growth; the intended visibility and fallback UX cannot be inferred from code alone.

options.title: Local indicator preference
options.body: Add a persisted Control UI setting for normal, compact/dismissible, or hidden indicator behavior while retaining another accessible scroll-to-latest action.

options.title: Keep current affordance
options.body: Retain the existing New messages pill as the consistent manual catch-up control and decline the additional preference.

options.title: Gateway configuration
options.body: Add a documented `gateway.webchat` option and accept the larger schema and compatibility surface for this browser presentation choice.

recommendation.title: Local indicator preference
recommendation.body: Add a persisted Control UI setting for normal, compact/dismissible, or hidden indicator behavior while retaining another accessible scroll-to-latest action.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available product-routing candidate from the current-main UI history and the prior issue review.
